originStory.title: Why I Built the Obsidian Starter Kit
originStory.subtitle: 20+ Years of Knowledge Management, Distilled
originStory.story: For over two decades, I've been obsessed with one question: How do we capture, organize, and leverage knowledge without losing our minds? I've tried every tool, every methodology, every system. I've failed spectacularly and refined relentlessly. Eventually, I built something that worked—a system that scaled from my first notes to tens of thousands, that grew with my career as an author, blogger, and entrepreneur, that made me more capable every single day. But it wasn't until I watched others struggle with the same chaos I had overcome—spending months recreating mistakes I'd already solved—that I realized this system needed to be shared. The Obsidian Starter Kit isn't a product I built to sell. It's the system I use every day, packaged so you don't have to spend years figuring it out yourself.
originStory.inspirationPoint: Watching talented people waste months on problems I had already solved

creatorJourney.subtitle: From Scattered Notes to Systematic Mastery

My information was scattered across tools that never talked to each other—and I was the only connection point, relying on my memory to bridge the gaps. The creative blocks were the worst part. I knew I had the pieces, but I couldn't connect them. I felt less competent than I should have been, struggling to leverage my own thinking. Sound familiar? That's exactly why I spent years refining this system—so you don't have to. Today, I use OSK daily with AI tools like Claude, and my knowledge genuinely compounds. Every note I create makes me more capable. That's the transformation I want for you.

methodology.title: The OSK Philosophy
methodology.subtitle: Four Principles That Make Knowledge Work

steps.title: Systems Over Willpower
steps.description: The system does the work, not your discipline or memory. Templates auto-file. Tags auto-organize. You focus on thinking, not housekeeping. When organization is automatic, consistency becomes effortless.

steps.title: Opinionated Structure
steps.description: Every decision has been made for you—but nothing is locked. You get a complete, working system from day one with no analysis paralysis. As you learn, customize anything. But you don't have to customize anything to be productive.

steps.title: Built for Evolution
steps.description: OSK isn't static. It's designed to grow and adapt as your needs change, as new tools emerge, and as AI capabilities expand. Free lifetime updates ensure your system evolves with you and with the future of knowledge work.

steps.title: Knowledge Compounds
steps.description: Every note you create should make you more capable, not just more organized. OSK is built around connecting ideas across time, projects, and domains—so your second brain genuinely makes your first brain smarter.

methodology.philosophy: Most PKM systems fail because they require constant effort to maintain. OSK succeeds because the system works for you, freeing your energy for what actually matters: thinking, creating, and growing.
methodology.differentiation: Unlike templates that give you empty structures or tutorials that leave you to figure out implementation, OSK is a complete, working system refined over 20+ years of real-world use. It's not theory—it's what I actually use every single day.

vision.title: The Future of Your Knowledge
vision.subtitle: Where This Journey Takes You
vision.mission: I believe your knowledge should compound like interest—every insight building on the last, every note making you more capable. OSK is designed to give you that compounding advantage, whether you have 10 notes or 10,000. My mission is to help you become a systematic creator: someone who produces consistently, connects ideas effortlessly, and grows through their knowledge rather than drowning in it.

values.title: Clarity Over Complexity
values.description: A system should bring clarity, not add another layer of complexity. OSK simplifies knowledge work by making organization invisible.

values.title: Growth Over Perfection
values.description: Your system doesn't need to be perfect to work. OSK is designed for iteration—start simple, evolve naturally.

values.title: Action Over Accumulation
values.description: Collecting notes is worthless if you never use them. OSK prioritizes retrieval, connection, and creation—not just capture.
